name: Synchron
what: Endovascular brain-computer interface (Stentrode, placed through a blood vessel)
notes: Registry query verified 2026-10-31: 7 studies; lead sponsor name varies by entity.

name: Blackrock Neurotech
what: Intracortical microelectrode arrays (Utah array) used in academic BCI trials
public_note: Counts trials where Blackrock is lead sponsor or collaborator. Many academic BCI trials use its arrays without naming it.

name: BrainGate consortium
notes: Registry query verified 2026-10-31: 7 studies. No sponsor filter: the consortium is named in titles not sponsors.

name: ONWARD Medical
what: Spinal cord stimulation to restore movement and blood-pressure control after spinal cord injury (ARC therapy)

name: mTOR inhibitors (rapamycin and rapalogs)
what: Inhibit mTOR, a nutrient-sensing pathway that extends lifespan in animal models

name: Metformin for aging
what: Diabetes drug tested as a general slowing of age-related disease

name: Dasatinib + quercetin (senolytic)
what: Clear senescent cells, which accumulate with age and drive inflammation

name: Fisetin (senolytic)
what: Plant flavonoid tested as a senolytic (clears senescent cells)
public_note: Some registered fisetin studies are supplement-industry trials; check the sponsor.

name: Joe Dispenza retreat studies
what: Week-long advanced meditation retreats led by Joe Dispenza, studied with UC San Diego
public_note: Both registered studies are single-group designs with no control arm.
notes: Registry verified 2026-10-31: NCT06583395, NCT06615531; collaborators Metamorphosis LLC and UC San Diego.

name: Exercise for aging (large randomized trials)
what: Aerobic, resistance and physical-activity programs tested against aging outcomes
public_note: Filtered to randomized trials with at least 300 participants; 1,357 exercise-and-aging trials are registered in all.

name: Fasting and caloric restriction
what: Caloric restriction, intermittent fasting and time-restricted eating
query_intr: fasting OR "caloric restriction" OR "calorie restriction" OR "time-restricted eating"

name: Meditation and mindfulness
what: Meditation and mindfulness programs tested against aging outcomes

name: Tai chi, yoga and qigong
what: Mind-body movement practices tested against aging outcomes

name: Heat and cold exposure
what: Sauna, heat therapy and cold-water exposure
query_intr: sauna OR "cold water" OR "cold exposure" OR "heat therapy"
